note: What a server sends to set where a missile starts from and how fast it travels, which restarts its flight. The header names the missile.

fields.name: fromX
fields.note: Where the missile starts, in world units, along one ground axis.

fields.name: fromY
fields.note: Where the missile starts, in world units, in height.

fields.name: fromZ
fields.note: Where the missile starts, in world units, along the other ground axis.

fields.name: velocityX

fields.note: How fast it travels, in world units a second, in height.

fields.note: How fast it travels, in world units a second, along the other ground axis.
